overview: The Medford City Council approved a $900,000 transfer from retained water earnings for West Medford brownfield site remediation and adopted a resolution asking the mayor to fund a municipal traffic engineer in the FY2018 budget. The Council also discussed bus stop safety concerns, received updates on speed limit reductions, and passed routine recognitions.

items.title: Vehicle for Hire Ordinance Committee Report
items.summary: Council voted to suspend the rules to receive a committee report on updated taxi regulations, laying over the full text for a vote at the next meeting.

items.title: West Medford Brownfield Remediation Funding Transfer
items.summary: Council approved transferring $900,000 from retained water earnings to perform chemical oxidation soil and groundwater remediation at the West Medford brownfield site.

items.title: Resolution for Municipal Traffic Engineer Funding
items.summary: Council approved a resolution asking Mayor Burke to appropriate funds for a full-time traffic engineer or retain a traffic consultant in the fiscal year 2018 budget.

items.title: Commending Newly Appointed Firefighters
items.summary: Council passed a resolution congratulating ten newly appointed firefighters on completing their training and joining the Medford Fire Department.

items.title: Recognition of Brittany Lanzilli
items.summary: Council passed a resolution commending Brittany Lanzilli on her selection to the 2017 USA Collegiate Hockey Team.

items.title: Petition on Zoning Board of Appeals Hearing Notices
items.summary: Council received and filed a resident petition advocating for earlier public notice of Zoning Board of Appeals hearings and stricter adherence to zoning ordinances.

items.title: Department of Public Works Water Main Break Report
items.summary: Council passed a motion requesting a report from the Department of Public Works regarding recent water main breaks across the city.

items.title: High Street and Main Street Bus Stop Safety
items.summary: Council approved a resolution calling for a Transportation Subcommittee meeting with state delegates to address public safety issues at the High Street and Main Street MBTA bus stop.

items.title: Traffic Commission Speed Limit Reduction Report
items.summary: Council President Caraviello reported that the Traffic Commission voted to reduce the citywide speed limit to 25 miles per hour on city-controlled streets.

items.title: Condolences and Memorial Dedication
items.summary: Council observed moments of silence for Alma Santoro and dedicated the meeting to the memory of former Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callahan.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Council approved the meeting minutes from December 20, 2016, and January 3, 2017.
